stories.title: Vance 'extremely skeptical' US struck an Iran wedding, despite NYT analysis pointing to a US bomb
stories.reason: The vice president downplayed the six-month conflict as he cast doubt on Iran's claim that US strikes killed 18 people nationwide, even as independent visual analysis identifies American munitions at the wedding site.

stories.title: Trump imposes tariffs up to 100% on foreign-made drones, targeting China
stories.reason: Drones over 55 pounds or with thermal imaging face the full 100% rate, while even allied manufacturers in Japan, South Korea and Europe face new tariffs, deepening the US-China tech decoupling.

stories.title: Lithuania warns Russia is 'highly likely' to escalate attacks on the EU
stories.reason: Following Germany's attribution of the Leipzig drone plot to Moscow, Lithuania's foreign minister is urging stronger EU-wide deterrence and says the country would move to a war footing if directly attacked.

stories.title: UniQure files for first-ever gene therapy approval for Huntington's disease
stories.reason: AMT-130 would be the first treatment to address the underlying cause of the fatal genetic disease rather than just symptoms, with three-year data showing it slows disease progression.

stories.title: Stocks jump and Fed rate-hike odds fall ahead of Friday's jobs report
stories.reason: The Dow's best day since early August came as traders pared bets on a September rate hike to roughly even odds, with economists expecting Friday's report to show 53,000 jobs added in August.

stories.title: Nvidia launches PAIR, a free tool that pools idle home computers into a personal AI cluster
stories.reason: Announced at IFA 2026, the free beta lets GeForce and Apple Silicon devices on a home network share the load of local AI inference and agentic workloads, encrypted end-to-end via mTLS.

stories.title: American missing in Nepal floods has been contacted, officials say
stories.reason: The contact with one of roughly 65 Americans still listed as missing is a rare hopeful development a week into a disaster where thousands remain unaccounted for.

stories.title: Rep. Massie launches new discharge petition to force DOJ compliance on Epstein files
stories.reason: The follow-up bill would let lawmakers, state officials and survivors sue the Justice Department over noncompliance, and comes amid accusations Speaker Johnson may recess the House to avoid a vote.
